text.en: Meena's uncle grew a high-yielding rice variety. "Plant breeding did this," he said.

The Green Revolution raised food grain production using high-yielding varieties, fertilisers and irrigation. Plant breeding develops better crops by methods such as introduction, selection, polyploidy breeding, mutation breeding and hybridisation. They aim for high yield, better quality and resistance to disease and pests.
Animal breeding includes inbreeding, which mates closely related animals, outbreeding, which mates unrelated ones, and heterosis, the extra vigour of hybrids.
Genetic engineering changes the genes of an organism and uses techniques like gene cloning. Biotechnology is used in medicine to make insulin and vaccines, stem cells can grow into different cell types, DNA fingerprinting identifies people, and genetically modified crops carry added genes.
